residuals.observation: The slogan occurs twice; the central instance is the largest copy. Invitation is small at the bottom-right of the caption instead of leading into the paragraph.

residuals.location: central paragraph and lower information at usage720
residuals.observation: Body syllables are about 10–11 pixels tall at usage720 and access/care/URL smaller; the complete text can be decoded but lacks comfortable body size.
A separate middle dot is inserted between date and hours beyond the supplied copy.
Care view is tall rather than square and occupies width that could support the explanatory caption.
The palette is predominantly warm yellow/green; plum/indigo and brush-built massing are weaker than the assigned direction.

observations.observation: Substantive overlapping philodendron and rubber-plant leaves have connected stems and window light.
Varied pots and a larger tree are visible on a table; a customer holds a pot to the right.
A fibrous root ball is held above an open clay-pot rim; the other hand steadies the pot and the plant stems grow from the ball.
Three unequal scenes form an L-shaped editorial frame around central copy; the large slogan is the dominant typographic anchor.
Paragraph has a stable left edge and four lines, then a short vertical step and rule to the market name, date/hours and venue.
Access/care and small invitation/URL are split by a rule, interrupting the intended single descending action path.

style.default_exclusion_observation: The tall botanical crop, broad market view and hands/root-ball view organize the whole poster. Central information is present, but imagery is substantive rather than small garnish; the observed primary copy and its relationship still need correction.

substantive_visual.observation: Plant selection, window life and repotting are visible through three content-grounded scenes.

hangul.observation: The native paragraph shows stable square syllable proportions, distinguishable counters and word spaces; small bodies compress significantly at usage720.

information_relationship.observation: Prose descends locally into event and visit details; invitation occurs at a remote lower position and URL follows it instead of the access/care pair.

function_contact.observation: URL reads leaves.example/market; no QR/logo requested or visible; link function itself is not tested.

material_edge_finish.observation: Brush-like facets and highlights are visible in foliage, bark, hands and sleeve; panel boundaries are straight. Pot rims and rooted plant contact are legible without a clear impossible join.
